name: mmoollllee/laravel-deployer
description: Shared Deployer recipes for in-place Git deployment of Laravel apps on Plesk / managed hosting: DB-snapshot pull, storage sync, maintenance-safe deploy, plus the artisan commands the workflow leans on.

suggest.deployer/deployer: Required to RUN the recipes (^8.0). Only needed where `dep` is invoked — a globally installed Deployer 8 works too, which is why it is not a hard dependency: the package is required in production for its artisan commands, and a deploy tool has no business shipping there.
suggest.spatie/laravel-db-snapshots: Required in the consuming app (local + remote) for the pull:db-refresh / pull:db-full tasks — provides the snapshot:* artisan commands.
